items.zh: 第四苾芻復有五種。一、乞匃苾芻，二、自稱苾芻，三、名想苾芻，四、破壞煩惱苾芻，五、白四羯磨受具足戒苾芻。
items.en: The fourth, monk, is of five kinds: the mendicant monk, the self-proclaimed monk, the monk in name only, the monk who has destroyed affliction, and the monk who has received full ordination through the formal fourfold motion.

items.zh: 第五精勤復有三種。一、止息犯戒精勤，謂能遠離一切不善身業、語業。

items.title: Section: Diligence Closes with Guarding the Senses and Eliminating Affliction Itself

items.zh: 二、止息境界精勤，謂密護根門，修防守念及常委念、如前廣說。三、止息煩惱精勤，謂能永斷見、修所斷一切煩惱，及於一切先所生起，或欲尋思、或恚尋思、或害尋思、或貪、或瞋、或諸邪見、或忿恨覆惱誑諂等，能往惡處那洛迦等諸險惡趣非沙門法，隨所生起能不忍受，尋即斷滅、除遣、變吐。當知此中，略有二種止息煩惱。一、止息隨眠，二、止息諸纏。
items.en: Second, diligence in stilling the objects of affliction: closely guarding the sense-gates, cultivating protective mindfulness and constant, deliberate mindfulness, as explained at length before. Third, diligence in stilling affliction itself: being able to permanently cut off every affliction abandoned at the paths of seeing and cultivation, and, whatever arises — whether it is desire, aversion, or harm, or craving, hatred, wrong view, or resentment, malice, deceit, or flattery — refusing to tolerate it, immediately cutting it off, expelling it, and casting it out. Know that here there are, briefly, two kinds of stilling affliction: stilling the latent seed, and stilling its active manifestation.

items.title: Section: One Gone Forth Closes the Six Synonyms — Topic Fourteen Complete

items.zh: 第六出家復有二種。一、於善說法毘奈耶中而出家者，二、於惡說法毘奈耶中而出家者。於善說法毘奈耶中而出家者，謂苾芻苾芻尼、式叉摩那、沙彌、沙彌尼。又若自能出離身中所有一切惡不善法，當知是名真實出家。於惡說法毘奈耶中而出家者，謂諸外道。或全無衣、或壞色衣、或塗灰等增上外道。復有所餘如是等類眾多外道。是故說言：若諸沙門、若婆羅門、若修梵行、若諸苾芻、若精勤者、若出家者，如是一切，是數取趣所有異門。
items.en: The sixth, one gone forth, is of two kinds: one gone forth within a well-taught teaching and discipline, and one gone forth within a poorly-taught teaching and discipline. Further, one who is able to personally free the body of every evil, unwholesome state within it should be known as one who has genuinely gone forth. This is why it is said: renunciant, brāhmaṇa, holy-life practitioner, monk, the diligent one, and one gone forth — all of these are simply the various synonyms belonging to a being who takes up rebirth again and again.

items.title: Section: How Many Kinds of Practitioner — Eight, by Four Causes

items.zh: 補特伽羅略有八種。建立因緣略有四種。
items.en: Practitioners, briefly, are of eight kinds. The causes establishing them are, briefly, of four kinds.

items.title: Section: Eight Kinds of Practitioner Fully Explained — All Four Causes Must Converge

items.zh: 云何八種補特伽羅？一、有堪能者，二、無堪能者，三、善知方便者，四、不善知方便者，五、有無間修者，六、無無間修者，七、已串修習者，八、未串修習者。云何四種補特伽羅建立因緣？謂由四種差別因緣，建立八種補特伽羅。一、由根差別故，有根已成熟及根未成熟。二、由瑜伽差別故，有善知瑜伽及不善知瑜伽。三、由加行差別故，有有無間、慇重修，及無無間、慇重修。四、由時差別故，有已長時修道及未長時修道。云何如是四種差別能為前八補特伽羅建立因緣？謂根已成就即有堪能者，根未成就即無堪能者。善知瑜伽即善知方便者，不善知瑜伽即不善知方便者。有無間、慇重修即有無間修者，此亦名為有常委修；無無間、慇重修即無無間修者，此亦名為無常委修。已長時修道即已串修習者，未長時修道即未串修習者。如是名為由根差別、瑜伽差別、加行差別及時差別，建立八種補特伽羅。若諸所有補特伽羅根未成就，彼於所有善知方便、有無間修、已串修習，如理、如法、如其善巧，皆不能辨。若諸所有補特伽羅根雖成熟，而未善知善巧方便，於諸所有亦不能辨。若諸所有補特伽羅根已成熟，善知方便，無無間修，即不能得速疾通慧。若諸所有補特伽羅根已成熟，善知方便，有無間修，未串修習，即於所有自所作事未得成辨。若諸所有補特伽羅根已成就，善知方便，有無間修，已串修習，彼於所有皆能成
items.en: What are the eight kinds of practitioner? The capable and the incapable; the skilled in method and the unskilled in method; those who practice without interruption and those who do not; and those who have long habituated themselves through practice and those who have not. … Whatever practitioner's faculties are not yet matured cannot accomplish any of this at all. Whatever practitioner's faculties, though matured, has not yet skilfully learned the methods, likewise cannot accomplish it. Whatever practitioner has matured faculties and skilful method, but lacks uninterrupted practice, cannot swiftly attain penetrating wisdom. Whatever practitioner has matured faculties, skilful method, and uninterrupted practice, but lacks long habituation, has not yet accomplished the task at hand. Whatever practitioner has matured faculties, skilful method, uninterrupted practice, and long habituation accomplishes everything.

items.zh: 辨，亦能獲得速疾通慧，於其所有自所作事已得成辨。

items.title: Section: Demonic Forces and Their Activities Open — Topic Sixteen

items.zh: 當知諸魔略有四種。魔所作事有無量種，勤修觀行諸瑜伽師，應善遍知，當正遠離。
items.en: Know that demonic forces are, briefly, of four kinds, while the activities demons carry out are countless. Every yoga practitioner diligently cultivating meditative practice should thoroughly and correctly understand these, and should rightly keep clear of them.

blocks.text: The last synonyms, then the fifteenth question: how many kinds of practitioner?
The mendicant monk, the self-proclaimed monk, the monk in name only, the monk who has destroyed affliction, and the monk who has received full ordination by the formal act.

Three kinds: in solitude; in stilling the objects of affliction ("closely guarding the sense-gates"); and in eliminating affliction itself. Venerable Miào Jìng: "casting out" requires deep observation of non-self; only then are the seeds removed.
"One gone forth within a well-taught teaching, and one within a poorly taught teaching." And: "one who is able to free the body of every evil should be known as one gone forth".

Capable and incapable; skilled and unskilled in method; practising without interruption and not; long habituated and not. "All four causes must converge." "Whatever practitioner's faculties are not yet mature cannot accomplish this at all"; with mature faculties and skill but without continuous practice, one "cannot swiftly" attain. Venerable Miào Jìng: the long-habituated have practised in past lives.

quiz.q: Of the five kinds of monk, which does Venerable Miào Jìng call legitimate?
options: the last two — affliction-destroyer and the fully ordained — are legitimate; the first three are not
quiz.why: "The mendicant monk, the self-proclaimed monk, the monk in name only, the monk who has destroyed affliction, and the monk who has received full ordination through the formal fourfold motion." Venerable Miào Jìng: the last two kinds are legitimate; the first three are not.

quiz.q: "Cutting off, expelling, casting out" is rendered in one sweep. How do the masters separate active affliction from its seeds?
options: Miào Jìng: casting out means deep insight into non-self, removing the seeds; Cháng Bǎi: only expelling the active form, seeds uncut, is stilling the manifestation
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "casting out" requires deep observation of reality and non-self; only then are the seeds of affliction removed. Master Cháng Bǎi: merely expelling affliction's active form without fully cutting its seeds — stopping its manifestation — is "stilling the active manifestation."

quiz.q: What does the text call "genuinely gone forth," and what does Venerable Miào Jìng say?
options: freeing oneself of every unwholesome state; grasping at conventional truth is being a householder, according with ultimate truth is going forth
quiz.why: "One who is able to personally free the body of every evil, unwholesome state within it should be known as one who has genuinely gone forth." Venerable Miào Jìng: anyone grasping and discriminating within conventional truth is a householder; if you accord with ultimate truth, you have gone forth.

quiz.q: How many kinds of practitioner are there, and what four requirements for the path does Master Cháng Bǎi name?
options: eight; mature roots, skill in method, uninterrupted practice, long habituation
quiz.why: "Practitioners, briefly, are of eight kinds. The causes establishing them are, briefly, of four kinds." Master Cháng Bǎi: the four requirements for accomplishing the noble path are mature wholesome roots, skill in method, uninterrupted practice, and long habituation.

quiz.q: What does Venerable Miào Jìng say "faculties" means in "faculties not yet matured"?
options: wholesome roots — matured in some, not in others
quiz.why: "Whatever practitioner's faculties are not yet matured cannot accomplish any of this at all." Venerable Miào Jìng: "faculties" here refers to wholesome roots — some have matured roots, others not.

quiz.q: What standard does Venerable Miào Jìng give for "one who has long habituated themselves"?
options: entering, abiding seven days, and emerging from absorption at will, with ease
quiz.why: "Those who have long habituated themselves through practice and those who have not." Venerable Miào Jìng: such a person enters absorption when they wish, abides when they wish — seven days if they wish — and emerges when they wish, with complete ease.

quiz.q: With matured faculties and skill but no uninterrupted practice, what happens, and how does Venerable Miào Jìng explain 常委?
options: cannot swiftly attain penetrating wisdom; 常 is uninterrupted, 委 is earnest — different words, same meaning
quiz.why: "Whatever practitioner has matured faculties and skilful method, but lacks uninterrupted practice, cannot swiftly attain penetrating wisdom." Venerable Miào Jìng: 常 means uninterrupted, 委 means earnest — different words, the same meaning.
